definitions.explanation: An overhead lattice or pergola built to support a {藤|ふじ} (wisteria) vine. The hanging clusters of purple flowers are a classic late-spring sight in Japanese parks and gardens.

examples.english: There is a wisteria trellis in the park.

examples.japanese: {藤棚|ふじだな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

examples.english: When May arrives, purple flowers hang down from the wisteria trellis — a stunning sight.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous {藤棚|ふじだな} sites — such as Ashikaga Flower Park and Kameido Tenjin Shrine — attract many visitors each year during the late-April to early-May bloom. The cascading purple flowers are a classic image in haiku and Japanese painting.
